health.title: Your Pulse

health.connectBody: We read your steps, sleep and heart data to score your recovery every morning and adapt today's workout — like WHOOP and Google Fit.
health.noWatch: Without a watch we only read steps from your phone. Recovery needs a watch that tracks heart rate and sleep.

adapt.red: Low recovery — we trimmed the volume and swapped cardio for an easy walk
adapt.yellow: Moderate recovery — one set less on accessory lifts
adapt.green: High recovery — go push it today 💪

health.privacy: Your raw health data stays private. Friends only see your step count, for step challenges.

health.watches_android: Pixel Watch · Galaxy Watch · Fitbit · WHOOP · Garmin · Oura

health.via_android: Anything that writes to Health Connect on Android
health.howBody: We compare this morning's HRV and resting heart rate with your personal 30-day baseline, and add your sleep performance versus your need. 67%+ = green, 34–66% = yellow, under 34% = red. Strain (0–21) comes from time in heart-rate zones (or active calories when zones are missing).

nudge.title: Motivation notifications
nudge.buttonHint: Write messages that push members to the gym, workouts and meals — for men and women
nudge.intro: Write the notifications that motivate members to go to the gym. Active texts go out automatically at their time — there's no publish step. A new or edited text goes out first to every member, then texts take turns (nobody gets the same text again before seeing the others), matching each member's gender and language. Want one out right now? Tap “Send now” under the text and choose who gets it and where it opens. Automatic sending is at most 3 a day per person, only between 8 AM and 10 PM.
nudge.when_gym: Sent an hour before their usual gym time (or 5 PM), if they haven't checked in today.
nudge.when_friend: Sent instead of “Gym” when a friend (mutual follow) checked in today and they didn't. {friend} = the friend's name.
nudge.when_streak: Sent at 9 PM to anyone with a 2+ day streak who hasn't checked in today.
nudge.when_workout: Sent at 9 AM when their plan has a workout today and they haven't started it.
nudge.when_meal: Sent at 1 PM if they haven't logged any food today.
nudge.noActive: ⚠️ No active Arabic text for {{who}}, so they won't get this type.
nudge.friendGender: The friend who beat them (for the Arabic verb form)
nudge.vars: Tap a variable to add it; the app fills it in for each member:
nudge.testSent: Sent to you ✅ Check the bell 🔔
nudge.empty: No texts here yet. Add the first one 👆
nudge.tooShort: Write a title and a message (at least 3 characters)
nudge.nobodyBody:
{{rule}}

Everyone who fits may already have had one of this type today (one a day), hit 3 today, or turned motivation off in settings. Try tomorrow or pick a text of another type.
nudge.rule_gym: “Gym” goes to members who haven't checked in today (and it isn't a rest day in their plan).
nudge.rule_friend: “Friend beat you” goes to members who haven't checked in today while a friend has.
nudge.rule_streak: “Streak” goes to members with a 2+ day streak who haven't checked in today.
nudge.rule_workout: “Workout” goes to members whose plan has a workout today that they haven't started.
nudge.rule_meal: “Meals” goes to members who track food and haven't logged anything today.
nudge.audAllSub: {{who}} · {{lang}} — even if the rule doesn't apply
nudge.audPickSub: Any account you find by search, whatever their gender or language
nudge.free: Even if they got one today
nudge.freeSub: Skips “one of this type a day” and “3 a day”
nudge.nobodyHint: Nobody matches these options. Try “All members” or turn on “Even if they got one today”.
nudge.quietNow: It's quiet hours now (10 PM – 8 AM). Turn on “Even in quiet hours” to send anyway.
nudge.respectNote: Anyone who turned off motivation in their settings never gets it. Variables without a value are filled with a general word (“your friend”, “your workout”).

policy.title: Ratings from real visitors
policy.body: You can only rate a gym after checking in there (or at a branch of the same chain). Every rating shows a “Verified visitor” badge.

policy.title: Gyms can't delete or edit
policy.body: A gym manager can't delete or edit your rating. They can only post a public reply under it.

policy.title: One rating per person
policy.body: Each user has one rating per gym and can edit or delete it any time.

policy.title: Reports
policy.body: Anyone can report a fake or offensive rating. The ARQ team reviews reports and removes violations.

policy.title: No paid ratings
policy.body: We don't sell ratings or rank them for money. Partnerships and ads never change rating order or numbers.

policy.title: Ads say “Ad”
policy.body: Any paid content is clearly labelled “Ad”.

policy.title: Crowd and peak data has no names
policy.body: “Here now” counts people who checked in within the last 6 hours and haven't checked out. Peak times average the last 8 weeks: numbers only, no names.

policy.title: Full price
policy.body: We ask gyms to show joining fees, VAT and minimum commitment, so the price you see is the price you pay.

policy.title: Your health data is yours
policy.body: Body, InBody, watch and food data is never used for ads, and a coach only sees it with your consent, which you can withdraw any time.

watch.featuresNote: Notifications reach your watch when your phone is locked. In the iPhone Watch app → Notifications → ARQ, keep “Mirror iPhone alerts” on. A full watch app is coming in a later version.
watch.workoutsEmpty: Record a workout in the Workout app on your watch (run, walk, ride…) and it shows up here.
watch.noSessionData: No watch readings during this session. Wear your watch while training.
watch.feat_bookings: Court and class booking confirmations and the one-hour reminder reach your watch
watch.feat_kcal: The «kcal left» alert and event reminders reach your watch

events.title: Tournaments & events
events.intro: Marathons, horse racing, hiking, shooting, boxing and motorsport across Saudi Arabia. Dates come from official sources, and you can set a reminder for the day before.
events.empty: No upcoming events right now. Check back soon.
events.sourceNote: Dates come from the organisers' official sites and may change. Check the official site before you go.
events.hiddenNote: This event is hidden from users. You can see it because you manage the app.
events.remindedHint: You'll get a notification at 9 am the day before. Tap the button again to cancel it.
events.remDenied: Notifications are off. Turn them on in your phone's settings to get the reminder.
events.remUnavailable: A reminder isn't available for this event (it's too soon or the date isn't confirmed).
events.adminIntro: Add and edit local tournaments and events. Users see them on the Tournaments & events page, and the nearest featured one shows in the home box.
events.none_current: No current events. Add the first one.
events.featuredHint: The nearest featured event shows in the home box
events.activeHint: Turn off to hide it without deleting
events.adminRules: An event leaves the app automatically after its last day. If the date isn't confirmed, add a date note: it shows instead of the date, and reminders stay off until you set a confirmed date.
events.adminSubNone: Add the events shown next to Stores
events.f_datesHint: Use the format 2027-02-05. Leave it empty for year-round activities.
events.f_noteHint: Shows instead of the date when it isn't confirmed, e.g. late January (date to be announced)
events.f_summaryPh: وش الفعالية، المسافات أو الفئات، ومين ينظمها
events.f_urlHint: The organiser's site or ticket page, starting with https://
events.f_imageHint: A landscape image you have the right to use (from the organiser or licensed), up to 5 MB. Without one we show the type's icon in ARQ colours.
events.tooBig: The image is larger than {{mb}} MB
events.err_title: Enter the event name (at least 2 letters)
events.err_endOnly: Add a start date before the end date
events.err_range: The end date must be on or after the start date
events.err_url: The link must start with https://

kcalAlert.title: Calorie alert
kcalAlert.intro: When a user logs food and has their chosen number of calories or fewer left for the day, they get one alert that day. Here you set the text and the default number; users can change the number or switch the alert off from the calories card.
kcalAlert.thresholdHint: 50 to 500. Each user can change it for themselves from the calories card
kcalAlert.placeholders: You can use: {n} = kcal left, {eaten} = eaten so far, {goal} = daily target
kcalAlert.err_threshold: The number must be between 50 and 500
kcalAlert.err_text: Enter the Arabic title and message
kcalAlert.ownerSubOn: Default {{n}} kcal left · edit the text

book.title: Book courts & classes
book.homeSub: Football, padel and tennis courts, yoga and Pilates classes
book.intro: Pick a sport, a place and a time. You'll get a confirmation and a reminder an hour before. Pay at the venue.
book.empty: No places for this sport yet
book.noPartnersYet: Booking with ARQ starts with the first partner
book.noPartnersBody: The places below are listed from their official sites, and you book on their site. Once they join as partners you can book right here.
book.sourceNote: Listed places come from their official sites and may change. ARQ doesn't take any payment.
book.ownVenue: Run a court or studio? Join as a partner
book.listedNoteTitle: Booking and payment on their site
book.listedNote: This place is listed from its official site. If it's yours, join as a partner from the Partner hub and take bookings through ARQ.
book.doneConfirmedHint: You got a notification with the time, and you'll get a reminder an hour before. Pay at the venue.
book.donePendingHint: You'll get a notification once the venue confirms, and a reminder an hour before.
book.noCourts: This place hasn't added its courts yet
book.noTimesToday: No times left on this day
book.requestHint: The venue confirms the request and you'll be notified.
book.noClasses: No classes in the next two weeks
book.rules: Cancel from My bookings before the start time. Up to 6 upcoming bookings per person.
book.reminderNote: You get a reminder an hour before every confirmed booking

venue.joinTitle: Join as a court or studio
venue.joinIntro: Add your court or studio, set your times and prices, and take bookings from ARQ users. Your venue shows after the ARQ team approves it, and payment happens at your venue.
venue.name: Venue name
venue.mapsHint: From Google Maps or Apple Maps, starting with https://
venue.aboutPh: Number of courts, surface, parking, lighting…
venue.priceHint: Shown to users; paid at the venue
venue.autoConfirmHint: Any free time is confirmed right away without your review
venue.imageHint: A photo of your own venue, up to 5 MB
venue.consent: I confirm I own or am authorised for this venue, and I agree that ARQ shows its details and times to users and sends me booking notifications.
venue.reviewNote: The ARQ team reviews your request and you'll be notified
venue.err_link: The maps link must start with https://
venue.noVenue: You don't have a venue yet
venue.stBody_pending: The ARQ team is reviewing your request. You can set up your courts and classes now.
venue.stBody_rejected: Open Venue details to see the note, then edit and resubmit.
venue.stBody_suspended: Your venue is hidden from users for now. Contact the ARQ team.
venue.courtsHint: Add each court by name. Times follow the booking hours and length in Venue details.
venue.classesHint: Classes repeat every week. Users book a spot and it's confirmed right away until the class is full.
venue.classRules: If you cancel a class that has bookings, cancel them from the Bookings tab with a reason so members are told.

adminUsers.title: Trainees
adminUsers.headline: Every ARQ account in one place
adminUsers.intro: How many trainees you have and their emails. Edit a name or username, or delete an account. Only you can see the emails.
adminUsers.summary: All accounts {{total}} · Partners {{partners}} · Email not confirmed {{unconfirmed}}
adminUsers.searchPh: Search by name, username or email
adminUsers.deleteBody: {{email}} will be deleted for good with all its data: workouts, food, measurements, InBody, posts and photos. This can't be undone.
adminUsers.partnerNote: Partner accounts are managed from “Manage partners” and can't be deleted here.

aiLimits.title: AI limits
aiLimits.intro: How many times a day each user can use AI. Changes apply to everyone right away.
aiLimits.barcode_per_day_hint: When a product isn't in the open database we search the web for it. Products already found are free and don't count.
aiLimits.meal_photos_per_day_hint: Each meal photo analysed by AI counts once.
aiLimits.note: Long-press − or + to change by 5. Rolling limit: each use frees up again 24 hours later.
aiLimits.ownerSub: Barcode {{b}} · meal photos {{m}} a day per user

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.toWake: to wake at {{wake}} with your full sleep need ({{need}} h)
sleep.cyclesTitle: Or sleep in full cycles (wake between cycles, feeling fresher):
sleep.ifNow: If you sleep now, the best times to wake: {{times}}
sleep.stepHint: Long-press + or − to move by half an hour
sleep.alarmReal: A real alarm like the Clock app: rings even on silent, and opens ARQ on your day from the alarm screen.
sleep.alarmNotif: A notification with sound at wake time. The real alarm needs iOS 26.
sleep.remindSub: You'll get a reminder at {{at}} to be in bed by {{bed}}.
sleep.summary: Go to bed at {{bed}} to get your sleep need ({{need}} h). Your need comes from your watch and updates daily; without a watch we use 8 hours.
sleep.okAlarm: Wake-up alarm set for {{at}} ⏰ — it rings like the Clock app.
sleep.okNotif: You'll get a notification with sound at {{at}}.
sleep.alarmDenied: Alarms are turned off for ARQ, so we set a notification instead. You can allow alarms in Settings.
sleep.notifDenied: Notifications are off for ARQ, so we can't remind you. Turn them on in Settings.
sleep.wakeBody: Time to get up. Your day starts now 💪
sleep.bedBody: Go to bed at {{at}} to get your sleep and wake up fresh.

planNew.title: New plan
planNew.intro: Pick how to build your plan — you can change it any time. Your calories and meals are worked out in every option.
planNew.aiSub: Workouts and meals based on your weight, goal, level and InBody report if you have one. Ready in about half a minute.
planNew.notesPh: e.g. knee pain, want to focus on chest, don't like fish
planNew.pickProgramSub: {{n}} ARQ programs (full body, push/pull/legs, glutes, home…) plus coaches' programs.
planNew.buildOwnSub: Choose your days and exercises from the library, with your own sets, reps and rest.
planNew.buildOwnSubEdit: Edit your current plan or start from scratch: your days, exercises and sets.
planNew.keepsMeals: Every option works out your daily calories and meals from your profile.
planNew.incomplete: Complete your profile first (height, birth year, goal and level) so we can work out your plan.
planNew.canLeave: You can leave this page — the plan is saved as soon as it's ready.
planNew.slow: Still working… if you leave the app you'll find it in «My plan» once it's ready.
planNew.readyBody: Your workouts and meals for the week are set. Good luck 💪
planNew.err_rate_limited: You've reached today's AI plan limit
planNew.errHint_rate_limited: You can make 5 plans a day. Try tomorrow, pick a ready program, or build your own.
planNew.err_network: The connection dropped before the plan arrived
planNew.errHint_network: If it was saved you'll find it in «My plan». Check your internet and try again.
planNew.err_failed: We couldn't build the plan right now
planNew.errHint_failed: Try again in a moment, or take the instant standard plan.
planNew.errHint_incomplete: Add your height, birth year, goal and level, then build your plan.

builder.title: Build your plan
builder.intro: Pick your training days and add exercises to each day from the library. Calories and meals are worked out from your profile.
builder.introEdit: These are your current plan's workouts: change days, exercises and sets as you like — your meals and calories stay the same.
builder.saved: Done! This is your plan now 💪
builder.clearBody: This clears the exercises here (your saved plan doesn't change until you tap Save).
builder.errNoDays: Pick at least one training day.
builder.errEmptyDay: Add at least one exercise for {{day}}, or remove it from your training days.

verify.title: Verification ✓
verify.ownerSubHint: Verify any account or remove verification
verify.headline: A ✓ for trusted accounts
verify.intro: Verified accounts show «ARQ verified coach ✓» on their profile and can publish programs and tips in Community without the rank requirement. Search any account to verify it, or remove verification from the list below.
verify.searchPh: Search by name, username or email
verify.verifyBody: Their profile gets the ✓, and they can publish programs and tips in Community without the rank requirement.
verify.unverifyBody: The ✓ disappears from their profile and Community publishing goes back to their rank. If they have an approved coach profile, it stops showing in the coach directory.

timeline.atGymNow: {{count}} of your friends at the gym now
timeline.plusA11y: Add to your timeline: photo, thought, gym or sleep
timeline.empty: Your timeline is empty. Add friends and you'll see each other's mornings ☀️, gym visits 🏋️, photos and thoughts here.
timeline.noticeBody: Your friends automatically see “Good morning ☀️” when you open ARQ in the morning, and when you check in at the gym 🏋️ — and can react and comment. You can turn either off in settings. Photos, thoughts and “Good night 🌙” are posted by you from the + button.
timeline.shareWakeSub: Once a day when you open ARQ in the morning (your alarm time or when you opened the app). If you post “Good night 🌙”, your timeline locks until you tap “Good morning”, and it shows how long you slept.
timeline.shareCheckins: When I check in at the gym 🏋️
timeline.shareCheckinsSub: When you check in, and “Workout done 💪” with how long you trained when you check out.
timeline.settingsNote: The timeline is only for you and your friends. Photos, thoughts and “Good night” are posted by you from the + button.
timeline.hiddenNote: Your gym presence is set to hidden, so your check-ins aren't shown to anyone even with this on.
timeline.checkedInToast: You're checked in at {{gym}} — your friends see it on the timeline
timeline.sleepLocked: Your timeline is locked while you sleep 😴 When you wake up, tap “Good morning” and your friends will see you're up and how long you slept.
timeline.wakeA11y: Good morning — I'm up, open my timeline
timeline.wokeToast: Good morning ☀️ You slept {{d}} — your friends can see it
timeline.wokeToastShort: Good morning ☀️ — your friends can see you're up
